extensions.description: Provides agent driven UI using the A2UI JSON format.

card.description: Reads and acts on your Gmail: finds the threads that need you, opens a conversation, drafts a reply for you to finish, and files mail with labels.
card.name: Gmail

scopes.organize: Write drafts and label your email

skills.description: Finds the mail that needs you: threads where someone is waiting on your reply, what arrived recently, what's still unread.
examples: Anything I need to deal with this morning?
Show me the emails waiting on a reply
Do I have any unread mail from this week?
skills.name: Inbox triage

skills.description: Opens one email thread and shows the conversation: who wrote what, in order, with the latest message — the one that needs answering — in full.
examples: Open the thread from my advisor
What did they say about the budget?
Show me that email about the schedule change
Read me the last message in that conversation
skills.name: Reading a conversation

skills.description: Writes a reply to a thread and saves it as a draft for you to review and finish yourself.
examples: Draft a reply saying I can make Thursday
Write back and say I'll have it by Friday
Reply to that thanking them and asking for the file
Draft a short answer declining the meeting
skills.name: Drafting a reply

skills.description: Files mail: adds and removes labels, archives a thread out of the inbox, and shows what labels exist.
examples: Take the receipts out of my inbox
skills.name: Filing and labelling
